verdict.rationale: Motion offers some natural-language-adjacent entry points—voice task creation via Siri, email-to-task conversion, and an AI workflow builder based on SOPs—but there's no evidence of a conversational/chat interface for operating the full product (projects, scheduling, prioritization) via free-form natural language; the API is a structured REST interface, not NL. missing for 10: dedicated NL chat/command interface, evidence of broad task/project operations via typed natural language, independent hands-on confirmation.
